definitions.explanation: A plastic card used in place of a metal key to unlock doors, common at hotels, offices, and apartment buildings. It is read by inserting or holding it over a card reader.

examples.japanese: カードキー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: to enter the room with a key card.

examples.japanese: カードキー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧なくなった。
examples.english: I forgot my key card and couldn't get into the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦オートロック→オートロック：09829_ootorokku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{出入|でい}り→出入り：06609_deiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カードキー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This apartment building has an auto-lock, and you need a key card to go in and out.

notes:
A card that functions as a key, typically for hotel rooms, offices, or auto-locked apartment buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カードキー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かざす→かざす：28115_kazasu⟧: to hold up the key card (to a reader)
- カードキー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧: to insert the key card
- カードキー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}する→再発行する：21951_saihakkousuru⟧: to reissue a key card

SIMILAR WORDS:
- キーカード: card key — an interchangeable variant order of the same two elements
- ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧: key — the general word, including physical metal keys
